title: Beachfront Babes | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: Beachfront Babes - Pet-Friendly Luxury Vacation Rental with Private Pool on 30A, Located Seconds From Beach Access w/ 1,500 Feet of Public BeachFavorite...
description_expanded: Beachfront Babes - Pet-Friendly Luxury Vacation Rental with Private Pool on 30A, Located Seconds From Beach Access w/ 1,500 Feet of Public Beach Favorite Features: - Private Pool (Heat Available) - Pet-Friendly - Elevator - Golf Cart - Elevator More about Beachfront Babes: Discover your slice of paradise in this stunning pet-friendly beach house in the charming community of Dune Allen Beach, Florida! Located directly across the street from the beach access, this coastal retreat offers unobstructed beach views, luxurious accommodations, a private sparkling pool, an elevator for added convenience, and room for up to 14 guests. Beachfront Babes   is the ideal getaway for your large group retreat, multi-family vacations, and your furry friends! Situated just steps away from the Dune Allen Beach access, guests can enjoy unparalleled access to the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico. The convenient location allows for spontaneous beach outings and captivating sunset views. This beach house goes beyond typical beach living with its private pool. Surrounded by a stylish patio, the pool area offers a private retreat for residents to unwind, swim, and bask in the Florida sun. Poolside loungers and shaded seating create an inviting space for relaxation.  Another notable feature of this beach house is its convenience-enhancing elevator. Whether transporting luggage, groceries, or simply providing easy access to different levels, the elevator adds a touch of luxury and accessibility to the home. This beach house exudes coastal elegance with high ceilings, ample windows, and a light color palette. The living room on the second floor provides comfortable seating and a flat-screen TV. The kitchen is well-appointed with modern appliances, solid surface countertops, and a breakfast bar seating four. The primary bedroom has a luxurious private bathroom with dual vanities, a soaking tub, a shower, and a toilet room for extra privacy. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Gulf waters from the balcony. After an incredible meal at Stinky’s Fish Camp, a short walk home to Beachfront Babes is a perfect way to soak in the charm of 30A. After indulging in their famous seafood gumbo, fresh oysters, or a perfectly grilled catch of the day, you’ll step onto the scenic path along 30A, where the salty breeze drifts in from the Gulf, immersing you in the beachside living experience. Here, even a simple walk can be a highlight of the night. Experience the perfect blend of convenience and relaxation as you indulge in a beachfront escape like no other. Don't miss your chance to soak up the sun and enjoy the stunning views—come and dive into the unforgettable experience awaiting you at Beachfront Babes! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 2:  2 Queen Beds & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 3: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo.  SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 4: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 5: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.  Bedroom 6: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Shared Balcony & Gulf View.
